subject: Connector partner onboarding — matching rules & clawback timeline
messages:
From: Nina Park <nina@bridgeops.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership: connector onboarding + lead routing questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking time on Friday. We started drafting internal ops for the Connector program and a couple items came up that will affect how we track referral flow and how we think about commissions: 

- Lead matching: we usually register leads by email + company domain and then do a 14-day attribution window for inbound demos. Can Redwood do deterministic matching on email/domain only, or do you require HubSpot/Hereo-style record ids?
- Clawbacks: our finance team prefers a 60-day clawback for MQL->Won reversals. Do you have an established clawback cadence for referral payouts?
- Bulk registration: we can share a CSV to register historical pipeline — any preferred format?

I've attached a short term sheet with our initial proposal (50/50 first-year rev share on connector-provisioned purchases; registration TTL 30 days). We're flexible but want to surface ops constraints up front.

Would appreciate a quick note on matching rules and whether Redwood's lead registry can accept the attached CSV. We aim to kick off onboarding next week.

Best,
Nina Park
Head of Alliances, BridgeOps
attachments: connector_term_sheet_v1.pdf
From: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
To: Nina Park <nina@bridgeops.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: connector onboarding + lead routing questions

Hi Nina — thanks for the clear write-up and the term sheet. Friendly intro: looping in Ben (Rev Ops) to confirm lead registry mechanics; Marissa (cc'd in followups) will own commercial approvals once ops align.

Quick answers/high level:
- Matching: Redwood's partner registry supports multiple matching keys. The deterministic default is email address (exact match) falling back to company domain for non-email leads. We also support a partner-provided unique ID (HubSpot/CRM id) if you want record-level fidelity.
- Attribution window: our standard is 30 days for referral credit, but we can make that configurable per-partner. Clawback periods are typically 90 days for revenue reversals; we can discuss a 60-day exception for BridgeOps if the expected churn profile is low.
- Bulk registration: CSV is fine; we have a template. I've attached the lead registry template and a short checklist for field mapping. Please confirm the columns you can provide.

Next steps: Ben, can you confirm whether a 60-day clawback is workable from a payouts/split perspective? Also confirm any recording we need during onboarding to map Lead->Opportunity states.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Nina Park <nina@bridgeops.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: connector onboarding + lead routing questions

Soojin / Nina — a few ops/commercial clarifications from Rev Ops and Finance: 

1) Clawback: Finance prefers 90 days as a blanket policy because it aligns with our payout cycle and chargeback exposure. Offering 60 days is possible but requires a manual exception ticket and changes to the Partner Payout SLA (we'll need to track retroactive adjustments). If BridgeOps expects steady conversion to closed-won within 30-45 days, we can do 60 days for the first 12 months as a pilot.

2) Attribution keys: For bulk uploads, our system will match on the following precedence: partner-provided CRM id -> exact email -> company domain. If you're sending historical rows without CRM ids, ensure an email column is present. The template Nina received includes a sample mapping.

3) Payout mechanics: We pay quarterly with a 30-day remit after quarter close. For rev-share, we compute partner percentage on net ARR recognized in that quarter. If we grant a 60-day clawback exception, payouts will include a flagged reserve bucket for those deals for 2 quarters to avoid premature distribution.

Attachments: connector_term_sheet_v1.pdf (redlined), lead_registry_template.csv

Action items:
- Nina: confirm you can provide email + company column in the CSV and whether BridgeOps wants the 60-day pilot.
- Marissa: if you sign off on the 60-day pilot, we'll route the exception to Legal for a short amendment to the Partner Addendum.

Ben Carter
Sr Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Nina Park <nina@bridgeops.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: connector onboarding + lead routing questions

Soojin / Ben / Nina — I reviewed Ben's notes and the redlined term sheet. I'm comfortable approving a 60-day clawback pilot for the first 12 months, with the following guardrails: 

- Pilot limit: applies up to $150k of recognized partner-attributed revenue. Above that threshold we default to 90 days unless Legal pre-approves.
- Registration TTL: we will accept BridgeOps registrations with a 30-day TTL; after that timeframe the lead will need manual validation to claim credit.
- Reporting: BridgeOps must submit monthly registration exports via the secure S3 folder (we'll share the upload details) and use the provided CSV template.
- Amendment: Legal to prepare a short amendment capturing the pilot parameters and clawback reserve treatment.

Nina — if that sounds good, I'll loop Legal and Partnerships will do a 30-min kickoff to confirm the CSV mapping and HubSpot webhooks.

Marissa Cole
Head of Channel & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
